decision: Prepare the Author Studio rich-text editor for release 17.24.0 with synchronized package, lockfile, Wrangler, HTML, service-worker, manifest and versioned asset references.
invariants: Service-worker cache key and core asset URLs use the 17.24.0 assets.
The editor JavaScript bundle is generated at build time and loaded only on Author Studio.
No production deployment, D1 mutation, or schema migration occurs.
acceptance: npm ci and full build pass.
Cloudflare dry-run reads the new versioned assets.
Route registry, migration governance, Graphify and source validation pass.
releaseBoundary: Release packaging only. Production deployment remains a separate manually confirmed action.
